panels.description: [Incomplete: no GenLayer explorer for Clarke yet.] Rewards: GEN minted to the set in the last finalized epoch (inflation). Stake slashed: GEN taken from validator + delegator stake since genesis (ValidatorSlash). Idleness quarantines: a validator failed to act on a transaction and was set aside (ValidatorBannedIdleness). Penalized votes: a validator voted with the minority or timed out and was charged a fee penalty (ValidatorPenaltyRecorded) — testnet fees are near zero, so these are counted, not summed in GEN.
